summary.headline: Stellar Conjunctions and Applications
summary.text: Catalog of astrological chapters 65–78 on stellar settings, retrogradations, direct motions, and conjunctions, especially those of Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars in the triplicities, zodiac signs, and twelve houses. It also covers timing indications, stars accompanying the Sun when burning, and the Moon’s applications after conjunction or full moon, with references to Stephanus of Alexandria, Apomasar, and Firmicus Maternus.
